The Applicant seeks his release on bail in connection  with FIR No.303 of 2025 dated 19th September 2025  registered with the Naya Nagar Police Station, District: Mira-  Bhayandar, Vasai-Virar for the offences punishable under Sections 26(2)(i), 26(2)(ii), 26(2)(iv), 59 of the Food Safety  and Standards Act, 2006 and under Sections 123, 223, 274,
 275 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 ('BNS').

sentences.text: Mr. Imran Shaikh, learned counsel appearing for the  Applicant, submits that the charge-sheet is not yet filed in the  Trial Court.
Admittedly, the issue pertaining to the said  offence, is pending before the Supreme Court.
3. The Applicant is found to be in possession of 1000  packets of pan masala valuing Rs.4,200/-.
Same are seized by  the Investigating Agency.
The Applicant is in custody for  almost 2 months and till date, charge-sheet is also not filed  before the Trial Court.
Since the contraband is already in the  custody of the investigating officials, there is no question of  tampering with the evidence.
4. In these circumstances, I am inclined to grant bail to the
Applicant
